messages:
emma: POC customer (Stratus) rotated a key and now getting 401s. Hit in staging at ~14:03 UTC. Can we swarm?

noah: can you paste the exact curl and response body? usually org slug vs project canonical name mismatch or scope.

emma: customer sent: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_stratus_new\" -d '{\"input\":\"ping\"}'` -> `{"error":"unauthorized","message":"invalid credentials"}` no request-id in body.

gael: checking auth logs: found request_id=7c3b9d for that token. auth: `warn auth: bind_failed token=sk_stratus_new err=invalid_org_binding tenant=staging-stratus token_org=stratus`

noah: looks like token is bound to org slug "stratus" but their project header resolves to "staging-stratus". quick repro: ask them to include `x-rw-org: stratus` in header to confirm.

emma: sent that. customer replies some of their infra strips custom headers via a middleware. they asked whether creating a token that allows both org slugs is OK.

gael: acceptable for short-lived POC keys. create a service key with allowed_orgs=["stratus","staging-stratus"] and limit scopes to what they need, TTL 48h. prefer issuing a new key instead of widening prod key.

ops-bot: automated: token-rotation detected key_id=sk_stratus_new rotated_by=emma@redwood at 2026-03-21T14:01:10Z.

noah: also double-check scopes: if they're calling streaming chat endpoints they need `generate:chat` not `generate:basic`. logs don't show insufficient_scope but verify.

emma: customer tested with `x-rw-org: stratus` and got 200 request_id=7c3b9e. they accepted temporary dual-org key.

sec-bot: automated: service-key-created id=sk_poc_stratus created_by=gael@redwood scopes=[generate:basic] allowed_orgs=["stratus","staging-stratus"] ttl=48h audit_note="poc-stratus temp key".

gael: I'll add an alias for the project mapping after sec signs off if they want fewer header changes; will add audit and TTL.

emma: AE follow-up: they want a ballpark for Dedicated for predictable latency during POC. I'll hand to @noah for pricing. Closing auth issue, will follow up on rotate/revoke steps after POC. :thumbsup:
